[NDET.4.1] Time-driven behaviour reads the engine's two clocks ([LTIM.2.8.1]); a
reproducible run must drive both from the recording, not from the host.

A replay of a recording needs no clock setup from the integrator: the replayer
drives both clocks from the trace ([NDET.8.2], [LFST.9.2.1]).

An integrator that drives an engine from its own record of inputs, rather than
replaying a recording, **must** drive the clocks itself. It switches the engine
to the mock clock before the first sample and advances it from the recorded
timestamps: `ds_engine_clock_set_mode(e, DS_CLOCK_MOCK)` then
`ds_engine_clock_set` / `_advance` — see [NLFC.5]
and [NTST]. Such a run on the live clock is not
reproducible.
